facts.subject: Darkness of Hallowvale
facts.statement: Darkness of Hallowvale's tome of experience grants 2,000 XP to any three skills at level 30 or over (the same skill may be chosen), i.e. up to 6,000 Agility XP on top of the fixed 7,000 Agility XP.
facts.caveat: Zerker build: the prerequisite chain (In Aid of the Myreque <- In Search of the Myreque <- Nature Spirit) carries fixed Defence XP of 2,000 + 600 + 2,000 = 4,600 per the wiki Quest experience rewards Defence table; none of those three are in the owner's quest list. The quest itself also needs Strength 40 and Crafting 32 (both unboostable) and Mining 20; the owner has Strength 32 and Crafting 21. The tome must never be read into Defence.

facts.statement: The wiki lists Death on the Isle's kills as two low-level enemies fought with no equipment, which the page says you cannot die to. Recommended combat level is 40.

facts.subject: The Graveyard
facts.statement: The Graveyard is announced to unlock an Agility 65 hybrid course aimed at Agility 65-80. Jagex projected 65,000-75,000 XP/h at high intensity and about 55,000-60,000 XP/h on the slower route, with the course meant to be the best mark-of-grace source when played at high intensity.

Ardougne rooftops will still give more marks than the Graveyard's low-intensity option. Re-verify actual rates after the 2026-11-25 release.

facts.caveat: These are theoretical maximums with no failures; the wiki estimates about 75 s per lap at 60-65 and about 55 s later because of failures. The 56,000 figure needs the hard Kandarin Diary, which this zerker can never finish.

rfi.question: Death on the Isle (fixed 7,500 Agility XP; the owner needs only Thieving 34): the wiki says the two no-equipment fights 'can't' kill you. Is that safe under the Hardcore Worlds death ruleset? Also give the enemies' names, levels and max hits, and whether you can leave or teleport mid-fight. This is the most likely quest in this range to be routed.

Rag and Bone Man III has a scripted illusory 'death' (the Odd Old Man one-hits the player, then a Death's Office / Oblivion / Tutorial Island loop, and Tolna's heads 'kill' you again). Does this count as a death on Hardcore Worlds? It is not Agility-relevant, but planners must not suggest it if it is run-ending.

Ardougne Diary: easy task 5 needs a Fishing Trawler start, and elite tasks need a Fishing Trawler manta ray and a Nightmare Zone salve imbue (docs/07 lists both activities as reported unsafe on Hardcore Worlds). Please rate them, since the elite Ardougne mark bonus depends on them.

decisions.decision: Combat-roster claims that omit enemies listed in the quest infobox's kills field are DISPUTED, with the full roster as value (C-QST-170, C-QST-211, C-QST-235).
decisions.reason: Charter: a changed value is DISPUTED, never VERIFIED. The roster is the claimed value and the infobox lists more enemies.
alternatives_considered: VERIFIED_WITH_CAVEAT listing the extra enemies (rejected: silently fixing the value)

limitations: Most sources are OSRS Wiki pages (T2). The Quest experience rewards table is a separately maintained wiki page, not a transclusion of each quest's reward template, but it is the same publisher, so it is a corroboration rather than a truly independent second source.
